items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: So he said, "I'm gonna let you bring your band in."

ctx.x: I really (inaudible) but he thought -- He say, "Where you get this band?" He came --
Schiffman came -- I was rehearsing downstairs right by that, (inaudible) downstairs. So he said, "I'm gonna let you bring your band in."
I say, "Okay, I'll bring my big band in." "Give me a price."
